name: Mini-sota Heartland Warm-Up I 2026
information:
### There is no 3x3 at this competition and it is held on a *Friday evening* 

##### This competition is **not recommended** for new competitors. It will only host 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, and 3x3 One-Handed.

[Click here for other upcoming Minnesota competitions.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?search=minnesota)
##### ____________________________________

Only 1 guest per competitor is allowed to enter the room to ensure we have enough space.
